summary: An applicability statement for OSPF, placing a requirement on vendors claiming conformance so that users can deploy OSPF in multivendor networks. It is historic.

eli5.summary: A promise that any company saying it supports OSPF must really do it, so routers from different makers can work together.

questions: what features of ospf are mandatory
subtitle: Vendor requirements to ensure OSPF routers can interoperate across different manufacturers.

tldr.problem: Users needed assurance that routers from different vendors could work together using OSPF as a common routing protocol.
tldr.mechanism: An applicability statement requiring any router vendor claiming OSPF conformance to implement the full protocol and the OSPF Management Information Base (MIB) with only TOS routing being optional.
tldr.outcome: This statement is now Historic, having served its purpose in the early OSPF era by guaranteeing multivendor interoperability.

today: RFC 1370 is marked Historic. It served its purpose in establishing OSPF as a mandatory standard for router vendors during the early 1990s. Today, it is superseded by broader IP router requirements standards and the current OSPF specifications.

sections.title: The Need for a Standard Routing Protocol
sections.content:
Users and vendors needed IP routers from different manufacturers to work together using a single interior gateway protocol (IGP). The Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) protocol was developed to meet this need as a high-functionality, non-proprietary, open standard available from all IP router vendors.

RFC 1370 sets requirements for vendors claiming OSPF conformance to ensure interoperability in multivendor network environments.
sections.eli5: Different companies were making routers that could not talk to each other. OSPF was chosen as the common language all routers should speak.

sections.title: Mandatory Implementation Requirements
sections.content:
Any IP router implementing a routing protocol must implement OSPF and the OSPF Management Information Base (OSPF MIB) for network management. All OSPF features are required except for TOS (Type-of-Service) based routing, which is recommended but optional.

This requirement does not prevent routers from implementing other routing protocols as well, allowing vendors flexibility to support multiple protocols. However, all conforming routers must support OSPF to guarantee interoperability.
sections.eli5: If a router is going to support any dynamic routing, it must support OSPF. Routers can speak other languages too, but OSPF is non-negotiable.

sections.title: Scope and Limitations
sections.content:
OSPF is designed for use by routers to exchange dynamic routing information between network devices. The RFC explicitly states that OSPF is not intended for hosts or end systems. Hosts should use other mechanisms like ICMP Router Discovery messages to learn about local routers.

This applicability statement is part of broader work on IP router requirements. The statement takes effect within the context of a larger standardization effort and is superseded where conflicting with other standards that emerge later.
sections.eli5: OSPF is for routers talking to routers about how to reach places. Computers at home use different ways to find routers on their network.
